result.summary: Pre-check gate zig build test-env-verify does not exit 0: 3 of 10 checks fail (C3 schema_migrations ledger 138 rows vs 137 files, C4 schema baseline delta=1, C5 test isolation lint MAJOR=7). issues.description: zig build test-env-verify exit 1 before 5-run sequence: C3/C4 (public.schema_migrations has 138 rows for schema_name=public while migrations/ contains 137 files; auto-fix did not resolve) and C5 (lint_test_isolation MAJOR=7, BLOCKER=0). 5-run acceptance gate halts at step 2 per handoff protocol. Requires ADHOC BACKEND-DEV to investigate the spurious schema_migrations row and either fix it or amend the pre-check acceptance criteria to C6-only.

Design-vs-implementation gap: Step.setJobs() was removed in Zig 0.16; the implementation keeps BPM_TEST_INTEGRATION_JOB_CAP / -Dtest-integration-jobs as a documentation/operator knob rather than the built-in -j cap the design called for. Primary mitigation (b) is not active during default zig build test-integration invocation; only mitigation (a) (600s raise) is active. CI must append -j8 explicitly. Should be documented in DOC-UPDATER retrospective.
